verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing says AI reads uploaded bills, fills in the details, and lets you approve and pay them. The docs back the approval step: vendor payments can carry optional approval controls, a "request to send money" follows the organization's approval policies, and gated disbursements wait for manual sign-off before funds are released. Missing for 10: detailed docs on bill upload and parsing beyond a one-line marketing claim, documentation of multi-step approval routing (approver chains, thresholds), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-approval workflow.
